description.value: Field & Social is a Vancouver salad-and-bowl concept founded in 2016, built around fresh-cut greens, scratch-made dressings, and locally sourced proteins and herbs. The Yaletown outpost on Mainland Street is one of four city locations and focuses on salads and bowls (sandwiches are Dunsmuir and Mount Pleasant only). An internationally trained chef leads the menu, which is consulted by a dietitian and rotates seasonally.

bike_parking_detail: 5 racks within 100m: stands at 63m; stands (2 spaces) at 95m; stands (2 spaces) at 97m; stands (2 spaces) at 98m; stands (2 spaces) at 99m. Total: 8 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content confirms the OSM address (1030 Mainland St, Vancouver, BC V6H 1E2), phone (604-423-5849), and email (yaletown@fieldandsocial.com), so contact fields are verified. The menu page explicitly labels several items vegan, gluten-free, and plant-based, confirming dietary options. No website content mentions bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, device charging, water refill, or pump; OSM tags do not supply these either, so those fields remain null. Takeout is confirmed via prominent 'Order Online' and pickup language throughout the site.
concerns: Contact page feedback dropdown lists Royal Centre, Dunsmuir, and Mount Pleasant but omits Yaletown — minor website inconsistency, no impact on operational status.
Sandwiches are explicitly listed on the menu page as available only at Dunsmuir and Mount Pleasant locations, not at Yaletown.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible café-style restaurant with confirmed contact details and an OSM check_date of 2026-04-27. Useful stop for touring cyclists seeking fresh, nourishing food in Yaletown.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu page labels Thai Peanut Satay as vegan; SOY MUSHROOM MISO BOWL, Chicken Tostada, and BEETS BOWL labeled gluten-free; SOY MUSHROOM MISO BOWL also labeled 'plant based option'
